risk_summary: The disclosure is broadly detailed and includes multi-year quantified operating data, but relies on standard estimation disclaimers and qualitative assurances regarding customer, supplier, commodity, and contract risks. Concentration among major customers and suppliers, declining standard beverage-container demand in North America, and reliance on adjusted performance measures are material credit considerations. Overall tone is cautiously confident rather than crisis-like.
